title: Scaling
description: How Helium, Silicon and rustc scale on the scaling suite: one knob varies, everything else is fixed.

list.name: knobmap
list.query: VALUES ('depth', ARRAY['depth', 'stmts']), ('enum', ARRAY['variants', 'payload']), ('loops', ARRAY['nesting', 'body']), ('seq_if', ARRAY['branches']), ('args_value', ARRAY['args']), ('args_ref', ARRAY['args']), ('args_mut', ARRAY['args']), ('call_depth', ARRAY['depth']), ('call_fanout', ARRAY['fanout']), ('mut_writes', ARRAY['writes', 'path']), ('arith', ARRAY['ops']), ('struct_depth', ARRAY['depth']), ('struct_width', ARRAY['fields']), ('tuple_width', ARRAY['elements']), ('enum_tag', ARRAY['variants']), ('enum_fields', ARRAY['fields']), ('option_depth', ARRAY['depth']), ('nway', ARRAY['arms']), ('seqmatch', ARRAY['decisions']), ('reborrow', ARRAY['reborrows']), ('condmove', ARRAY['moves']), ('generic', ARRAY['round_trips']), ('impls', ARRAY['impls']), ('units', ARRAY['units']), ('straight', ARRAY['statements']), ('pcalias', ARRAY['chunks'])
list.description: Knob names per family, in file-name order (the scaling families' `knobs` in runner/suite.example.json). Knob values are the numbers in the test name, in order.

list.name: family
list.label: Family
list.description: Scaling family (one benchmark per knob setting).
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT family FROM benchmarks WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT family FROM benchmarks WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: knob
list.label: Knob (x-axis)
list.description: Knob on the x-axis. Families with two knobs keep the other one fixed, see Fixed.
list.query:
WITH m(family, knobs) AS (${knobmap:raw}),
n AS (SELECT max(cardinality(array(SELECT m[1]::int FROM regexp_matches(test, '(\d+)', 'g') WITH ORDINALITY AS r(m, o) ORDER BY o))) AS n FROM benchmarks WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring})
SELECT i AS __value, coalesce((SELECT knobs[i] FROM m WHERE family = ${family:sqlstring}), 'knob ' || i) AS __text
FROM n, generate_series(1, greatest(n.n, 1)) AS i ORDER BY i
list.definition:
WITH m(family, knobs) AS (${knobmap:raw}),
n AS (SELECT max(cardinality(array(SELECT m[1]::int FROM regexp_matches(test, '(\d+)', 'g') WITH ORDINALITY AS r(m, o) ORDER BY o))) AS n FROM benchmarks WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring})
SELECT i AS __value, coalesce((SELECT knobs[i] FROM m WHERE family = ${family:sqlstring}), 'knob ' || i) AS __text
FROM n, generate_series(1, greatest(n.n, 1)) AS i ORDER BY i

list.name: fixed
list.label: Fixed
list.description: Values of the other knobs of the family; no other knobs for one-knob families.
list.query:
WITH m(family, knobs) AS (${knobmap:raw}),
o AS (SELECT DISTINCT k[:${knob:raw} - 1] || k[${knob:raw} + 1:] AS rest
      FROM (SELECT array(SELECT m[1]::int FROM regexp_matches(test, '(\d+)', 'g') WITH ORDINALITY AS r(m, o) ORDER BY o) AS k FROM benchmarks WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring}) t)
SELECT rest::text AS __value, coalesce((
  SELECT string_agg(coalesce((SELECT knobs[j + (j >= ${knob:raw})::int] FROM m WHERE family = ${family:sqlstring}),
                             'knob ' || (j + (j >= ${knob:raw})::int)) || ' = ' || v, ', ' ORDER BY j)
  FROM unnest(rest) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(v, j)), 'no other knobs') AS __text
FROM o ORDER BY rest
list.definition:
WITH m(family, knobs) AS (${knobmap:raw}),
o AS (SELECT DISTINCT k[:${knob:raw} - 1] || k[${knob:raw} + 1:] AS rest
      FROM (SELECT array(SELECT m[1]::int FROM regexp_matches(test, '(\d+)', 'g') WITH ORDINALITY AS r(m, o) ORDER BY o) AS k FROM benchmarks WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring}) t)
SELECT rest::text AS __value, coalesce((
  SELECT string_agg(coalesce((SELECT knobs[j + (j >= ${knob:raw})::int] FROM m WHERE family = ${family:sqlstring}),
                             'knob ' || (j + (j >= ${knob:raw})::int)) || ' = ' || v, ', ' ORDER BY j)
  FROM unnest(rest) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(v, j)), 'no other knobs') AS __text
FROM o ORDER BY rest

panels.title: Absolute
panels.description: Median ${metric:text} per knob value, all three backends on one axis. Dashed: the best fit from the fit table (click a legend entry to isolate a series).

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT 'Helium' AS backend, test, ${metric:raw} AS y FROM helium_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${helium_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Silicon', test, ${metric:raw} FROM silicon_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${silicon_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rustc', test, ${metric:raw} FROM rustc_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${rustc_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
),
pts AS (
  SELECT backend, k[${knob:raw}]::float8 AS x, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y) AS y
  FROM (SELECT runs.*, array(SELECT m[1]::int FROM regexp_matches(test, '(\d+)', 'g') WITH ORDINALITY AS r(m, o) ORDER BY o) AS k FROM runs) q
  WHERE y IS NOT NULL AND (k[:${knob:raw} - 1] || k[${knob:raw} + 1:])::text = ${fixed:sqlstring}
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
st AS (
  SELECT backend, count(*) AS n, min(x) AS x0, max(x) AS x1, min(y) AS ymin, max(y) AS ymax,
         regr_intercept(y, x) AS la, regr_slope(y, x) AS lb, regr_syy(y, x) AS sst
  FROM pts GROUP BY 1
),
poly AS (
  SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (backend) backend, k, a, b, sse FROM (
    SELECT g.backend, g.k, g.a, g.b, sum((p.y - g.a - g.b * power(p.x, g.k)) ^ 2) AS sse
    FROM (SELECT backend, k, regr_intercept(y, power(x, k)) AS a, regr_slope(y, power(x, k)) AS b
          FROM pts, generate_series(0.10, 6.00, 0.02) AS k GROUP BY 1, 2) g
    JOIN pts p USING (backend) WHERE g.b > 0 AND g.a >= 0 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) c
  ORDER BY backend, sse) d WHERE k < 5.99
),
expo AS (
  SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (backend) backend, r, a, b, sse FROM (
    SELECT g.backend, g.r, g.a, g.b, sum((p.y - g.a - g.b * exp(g.r * (p.x - st.x0))) ^ 2) AS sse
    FROM (SELECT backend, r, regr_intercept(y, exp(r * (x - x0))) AS a, regr_slope(y, exp(r * (x - x0))) AS b
          FROM (SELECT pts.*, st.x0, exp(ln(0.05) + i * ln(40 / 0.05) / 199) / (st.x1 - st.x0) AS r
                FROM pts JOIN st USING (backend), generate_series(0, 199) AS i WHERE st.x1 > st.x0) q
          GROUP BY 1, 2) g
    JOIN pts p USING (backend) JOIN st USING (backend) WHERE g.b > 0 AND g.a >= 0 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) c
  ORDER BY backend, sse) d JOIN st USING (backend) WHERE d.r * (st.x1 - st.x0) < 39.9
),
fit AS (
  SELECT st.*, poly.k, poly.a AS pa, poly.b AS pb, expo.r, expo.a AS ea, expo.b AS eb,
         1 - (sum((p.y - st.la - st.lb * p.x) ^ 2) / nullif(st.n - 2, 0)) / nullif(st.sst / (st.n - 1), 0) AS lin_r2,
         CASE WHEN st.n >= 4 THEN 1 - (poly.sse / (st.n - 3)) / nullif(st.sst / (st.n - 1), 0) END AS poly_r2,
         CASE WHEN st.n >= 4 THEN 1 - (expo.sse / (st.n - 3)) / nullif(st.sst / (st.n - 1), 0) END AS exp_r2
  FROM st JOIN pts p USING (backend) LEFT JOIN poly USING (backend) LEFT JOIN expo USING (backend)
  GROUP BY st.backend, st.n, st.x0, st.x1, st.ymin, st.ymax, st.la, st.lb, st.sst,
           poly.k, poly.a, poly.b, expo.r, expo.a, expo.b, poly.sse, expo.sse
),
best AS (
  SELECT fit.*, CASE
    WHEN n < 3 THEN 'too few points'
    WHEN ymax < 1.1 * ymin THEN 'flat'
    WHEN n = 3 AND lin_r2 < 0.99 THEN 'unclear'
    WHEN coalesce(lin_r2, 1) >= greatest(coalesce(poly_r2, -1e9), coalesce(exp_r2, -1e9)) - 0.01 THEN 'linear'
    WHEN coalesce(poly_r2, -1e9) >= coalesce(exp_r2, -1e9) THEN
      CASE WHEN k BETWEEN 0.85 AND 1.15 THEN 'linear' WHEN k < 1 THEN 'sublinear' ELSE 'polynomial' END
    ELSE 'exponential' END AS model
  FROM fit
),
grid AS (
  SELECT backend, x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / 60.0 AS x FROM best, generate_series(0, 60) AS i WHERE x1 > x0
  UNION SELECT backend, x FROM pts
),
curve AS (
  SELECT g.backend, g.x, CASE
    WHEN b.model IN ('polynomial', 'sublinear') THEN b.pa + b.pb * power(g.x, b.k)
    WHEN b.model = 'exponential' THEN b.ea + b.eb * exp(b.r * (g.x - b.x0))
    WHEN b.model IN ('linear', 'flat') THEN b.la + b.lb * g.x END AS f
  FROM grid g JOIN best b USING (backend)
),
both_ AS (
  SELECT c.backend, c.x, p.y, c.f FROM curve c LEFT JOIN pts p USING (backend, x)
)
SELECT x,
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Helium') AS "Helium",
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Silicon') AS "Silicon",
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'rustc') AS "rustc",
  max(f) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Helium') AS "Helium fit",
  max(f) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Silicon') AS "Silicon fit",
  max(f) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'rustc') AS "rustc fit"
FROM both_ GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Relative to each backend's smallest value
panels.description: Each backend divided by its own smallest median, so constant start-up cost (JVM, cargo) drops out and only the growth is compared.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT 'Helium' AS backend, test, ${metric:raw} AS y FROM helium_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${helium_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Silicon', test, ${metric:raw} FROM silicon_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${silicon_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rustc', test, ${metric:raw} FROM rustc_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${rustc_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
),
pts AS (
  SELECT backend, k[${knob:raw}]::float8 AS x, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y) AS y
  FROM (SELECT runs.*, array(SELECT m[1]::int FROM regexp_matches(test, '(\d+)', 'g') WITH ORDINALITY AS r(m, o) ORDER BY o) AS k FROM runs) q
  WHERE y IS NOT NULL AND (k[:${knob:raw} - 1] || k[${knob:raw} + 1:])::text = ${fixed:sqlstring}
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
rel AS (SELECT backend, x, y / nullif(min(y) OVER (PARTITION BY backend), 0) AS y FROM pts)
SELECT x,
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Helium') AS "Helium",
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Silicon') AS "Silicon",
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'rustc') AS "rustc"
FROM rel GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Best-fitting growth curve
panels.description: Least-squares fits of the absolute medians, each with a free offset a (start-up time): linear a + b·x, polynomial a + b·x^k (k searched in 0.1..6), exponential a + b·e^(r·(x − x0)). Ranked by adjusted R² (curved models have one parameter more); linear wins ties within 0.01, a polynomial with k in 0.85..1.15 counts as linear, and less than 10% growth is flat. Polynomial vs. exponential needs at least 4 points (3 points that are not on a line: unclear); with few points treat the verdict as a hint.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT 'Helium' AS backend, test, ${metric:raw} AS y FROM helium_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${helium_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})

  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${silicon_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rustc', test, ${metric:raw} FROM rustc_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${rustc_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
),
pts AS (
  SELECT backend, k[${knob:raw}]::float8 AS x, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y) AS y
  FROM (SELECT runs.*, array(SELECT m[1]::int FROM regexp_matches(test, '(\d+)', 'g') WITH ORDINALITY AS r(m, o) ORDER BY o) AS k FROM runs) q
  WHERE y IS NOT NULL AND (k[:${knob:raw} - 1] || k[${knob:raw} + 1:])::text = ${fixed:sqlstring}
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
st AS (
  SELECT backend, count(*) AS n, min(x) AS x0, max(x) AS x1, min(y) AS ymin, max(y) AS ymax,
         regr_intercept(y, x) AS la, regr_slope(y, x) AS lb, regr_syy(y, x) AS sst
  FROM pts GROUP BY 1
),
poly AS (
  SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (backend) backend, k, a, b, sse FROM (
    SELECT g.backend, g.k, g.a, g.b, sum((p.y - g.a - g.b * power(p.x, g.k)) ^ 2) AS sse
    FROM (SELECT backend, k, regr_intercept(y, power(x, k)) AS a, regr_slope(y, power(x, k)) AS b
          FROM pts, generate_series(0.10, 6.00, 0.02) AS k GROUP BY 1, 2) g
    JOIN pts p USING (backend) WHERE g.b > 0 AND g.a >= 0 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) c
  ORDER BY backend, sse) d WHERE k < 5.99
),
expo AS (
  SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (backend) backend, r, a, b, sse FROM (
    SELECT g.backend, g.r, g.a, g.b, sum((p.y - g.a - g.b * exp(g.r * (p.x - st.x0))) ^ 2) AS sse
    FROM (SELECT backend, r, regr_intercept(y, exp(r * (x - x0))) AS a, regr_slope(y, exp(r * (x - x0))) AS b
          FROM (SELECT pts.*, st.x0, exp(ln(0.05) + i * ln(40 / 0.05) / 199) / (st.x1 - st.x0) AS r
                FROM pts JOIN st USING (backend), generate_series(0, 199) AS i WHERE st.x1 > st.x0) q
          GROUP BY 1, 2) g
    JOIN pts p USING (backend) JOIN st USING (backend) WHERE g.b > 0 AND g.a >= 0 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) c
  ORDER BY backend, sse) d JOIN st USING (backend) WHERE d.r * (st.x1 - st.x0) < 39.9
),
fit AS (
  SELECT st.*, poly.k, poly.a AS pa, poly.b AS pb, expo.r, expo.a AS ea, expo.b AS eb,
         1 - (sum((p.y - st.la - st.lb * p.x) ^ 2) / nullif(st.n - 2, 0)) / nullif(st.sst / (st.n - 1), 0) AS lin_r2,
         CASE WHEN st.n >= 4 THEN 1 - (poly.sse / (st.n - 3)) / nullif(st.sst / (st.n - 1), 0) END AS poly_r2,
         CASE WHEN st.n >= 4 THEN 1 - (expo.sse / (st.n - 3)) / nullif(st.sst / (st.n - 1), 0) END AS exp_r2
  FROM st JOIN pts p USING (backend) LEFT JOIN poly USING (backend) LEFT JOIN expo USING (backend)
  GROUP BY st.backend, st.n, st.x0, st.x1, st.ymin, st.ymax, st.la, st.lb, st.sst,
           poly.k, poly.a, poly.b, expo.r, expo.a, expo.b, poly.sse, expo.sse
),
best AS (
  SELECT fit.*, CASE
    WHEN n < 3 THEN 'too few points'
    WHEN ymax < 1.1 * ymin THEN 'flat'
    WHEN n = 3 AND lin_r2 < 0.99 THEN 'unclear'
    WHEN coalesce(lin_r2, 1) >= greatest(coalesce(poly_r2, -1e9), coalesce(exp_r2, -1e9)) - 0.01 THEN 'linear'
    WHEN coalesce(poly_r2, -1e9) >= coalesce(exp_r2, -1e9) THEN
      CASE WHEN k BETWEEN 0.85 AND 1.15 THEN 'linear' WHEN k < 1 THEN 'sublinear' ELSE 'polynomial' END
    ELSE 'exponential' END AS model
  FROM fit
)
SELECT backend AS "Backend", model AS "Best fit",
  CASE model
    WHEN 'exponential' THEN 'a + b·e^(r·(x − ' || x0 || '))'
    WHEN 'polynomial' THEN 'a + b·x^k' WHEN 'sublinear' THEN 'a + b·x^k'
    WHEN 'too few points' THEN NULL WHEN 'unclear' THEN NULL ELSE 'a + b·x' END AS "Model",
  CASE model WHEN 'exponential' THEN ea WHEN 'polynomial' THEN pa WHEN 'sublinear' THEN pa ELSE la END AS "a (offset)",
  CASE model WHEN 'exponential' THEN eb WHEN 'polynomial' THEN pb WHEN 'sublinear' THEN pb ELSE lb END AS "b",
  CASE model
    WHEN 'exponential' THEN '×' || round(exp(r)::numeric, 3) || ' per +1 (doubles every ' || round((ln(2) / r)::numeric, 2) || ')'
    WHEN 'polynomial' THEN 'k = ' || round(k::numeric, 2) WHEN 'sublinear' THEN 'k = ' || round(k::numeric, 2) END AS "Growth",
  lin_r2 AS "adj. R² linear", poly_r2 AS "adj. R² polynomial", k AS "best k", exp_r2 AS "adj. R² exponential",
  n AS "Points", ymax / nullif(ymin, 0) AS "max / min"
FROM best ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['Helium', 'Silicon', 'rustc'], backend)

    WHEN n < 3 THEN 'too few points'
    WHEN ymax < 1.1 * ymin THEN 'flat'
    WHEN n = 3 AND lin_r2 < 0.99 THEN 'unclear'
    WHEN coalesce(lin_r2, 1) >= greatest(coalesce(poly_r2, -1e9), coalesce(exp_r2, -1e9)) - 0.01 THEN 'linear'
    WHEN coalesce(poly_r2, -1e9) >= coalesce(exp_r2, -1e9) THEN
      CASE WHEN k BETWEEN 0.85 AND 1.15 THEN 'linear' WHEN k < 1 THEN 'sublinear' ELSE 'polynomial' END
    ELSE 'exponential' END AS model
  FROM fit
),
grid AS (
  SELECT backend, x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / 60.0 AS x FROM best, generate_series(0, 60) AS i WHERE x1 > x0
  UNION SELECT backend, x FROM pts
),
curve AS (
  SELECT g.backend, g.x, CASE
    WHEN b.model IN ('polynomial', 'sublinear') THEN b.pa + b.pb * power(g.x, b.k)
    WHEN b.model = 'exponential' THEN b.ea + b.eb * exp(b.r * (g.x - b.x0))
    WHEN b.model IN ('linear', 'flat') THEN b.la + b.lb * g.x END AS f
  FROM grid g JOIN best b USING (backend)
),
both_ AS (
  SELECT c.backend, c.x, p.y, c.f FROM curve c LEFT JOIN pts p USING (backend, x)
)
SELECT x,
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Helium') AS "Helium",
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Silicon') AS "Silicon",
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'rustc') AS "rustc",
  max(f) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Helium') AS "Helium fit",
  max(f) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Silicon') AS "Silicon fit",
  max(f) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'rustc') AS "rustc fit"
FROM both_ GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Relative (log-log)
panels.description: Each backend divided by its own smallest median, so constant start-up cost (JVM, cargo) drops out and only the growth is compared.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT 'Helium' AS backend, test, ${metric:raw} AS y FROM helium_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${helium_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Silicon', test, ${metric:raw} FROM silicon_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${silicon_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rustc', test, ${metric:raw} FROM rustc_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${rustc_version:sqlstring} AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
),
pts AS (
  SELECT backend, k[${knob:raw}]::float8 AS x, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y) AS y
  FROM (SELECT runs.*, array(SELECT m[1]::int FROM regexp_matches(test, '(\d+)', 'g') WITH ORDINALITY AS r(m, o) ORDER BY o) AS k FROM runs) q
  WHERE y IS NOT NULL AND (k[:${knob:raw} - 1] || k[${knob:raw} + 1:])::text = ${fixed:sqlstring}
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
rel AS (SELECT backend, x, y / nullif(min(y) OVER (PARTITION BY backend), 0) AS y FROM pts)
SELECT x,
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Helium') AS "Helium",
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'Silicon') AS "Silicon",
  max(y) FILTER (WHERE backend = 'rustc') AS "rustc"
FROM rel GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Runs per status
panels.description: All timed iterations of the selected versions, by status. Points missing from the graphs usually timed out or crashed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT 'Helium' AS backend, test, status FROM helium_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${helium_version:sqlstring}
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Silicon', test, status FROM silicon_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${silicon_version:sqlstring}
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rustc', test, status FROM rustc_runs
  WHERE suite = 'scaling' AND family = ${family:sqlstring} AND backend_version = ${rustc_version:sqlstring}
)
SELECT backend AS "Backend", k[${knob:raw}] AS "${knob:text}", min(test) AS "Test",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'VERIFIED') AS "VERIFIED",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS "FAILED",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'INCONCLUSIVE') AS "INCONCLUSIVE",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CRASHED') AS "CRASHED",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'TIMED_OUT') AS "TIMED_OUT",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SKIPPED') AS "SKIPPED"
FROM (SELECT runs.*, array(SELECT m[1]::int FROM regexp_matches(test, '(\d+)', 'g') WITH ORDINALITY AS r(m, o) ORDER BY o) AS k FROM runs) q
WHERE (k[:${knob:raw} - 1] || k[${knob:raw} + 1:])::text = ${fixed:sqlstring}
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['Helium', 'Silicon', 'rustc'], backend), 2
